title: Hyperinsulinemic-Hypoglycemic Clamp Protocol in Mice
author: Li Kang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yycfxsw

steps.title: Perform Surgical Catheterization
steps.instruction: Perform surgical catheterization of the carotid artery and jugular vein in mice at least 5 days prior to the day of the study.

steps.title: Initiate Fasting
steps.instruction: Weigh the mouse and start the fast (suggested starting time between 7:00 and 8:00 AM) by placing the mouse in a plastic container with fresh bedding.

steps.title: Connect Mouse to Swivel
steps.instruction: Hook the mouse up to the swivel 3 hours into the fasting period.

steps.title: Perform Hyperinsulinemic-Hypoglycemic Clamp
steps.instruction: After a total 5 hour fast, initiate a constant insulin infusion and maintain blood glucose at a hypoglycemic level (~60mg/dL) by adjusting the infusion of 20% glucose.

substeps.instruction: Infuse donor blood into the jugular vein catheter throughout the study to prevent a fall of hematocrit

steps.title: Collect Blood Samples
steps.instruction: Collect blood samples at specified time intervals for hormone and glucose analysis.

substeps.instruction: Plasma insulin: 25 μl plasma at 0 and 120 minutes
Plasma glucagon: 25 μl plasma at 0, 30, and 120 minutes
Catecholamines: 100 μl whole blood at 0, 30, and 120 minutes

steps.title: Harvest Tissues
steps.instruction: At the end of the study, anesthetize the mouse, harvest tissues of interest, and freeze them in liquid nitrogen.
